title: Mouse wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,34 62,34' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='4' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
  <rect x='37' y='32' width='26' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ffe14d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='11' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='11' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='40' r='6.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='40' r='6.5' fill='#ffb3d1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#cfcfe8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#eaeaF8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='3.5' fill='#ff5a8a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='4' fill='#3a3a6e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='4' fill='#3a3a6e'/>
  <circle cx='43.3' cy='50.7' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.3' cy='50.7' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='62' x2='40' y2='64' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='70' x2='40' y2='68' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='62' x2='60' y2='64' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='70' x2='60' y2='68' stroke='#9a9ac0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 70 Q50 74 54 70' stroke='#ff5a8a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#eaeaF8'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='90' r='5' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='90' r='5' fill='#b9b9d6'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M66 92 Q80 96 80 84' stroke='#ffb3d1' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
